chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 472 – Ji Ning's Heartforce Breakthrough & Farewell
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning faces a hundred warriors in the Realm of Annihilation. Desperate and out of options, his Heartforce transcends to the Mastery Realm, and he discovers the enemies' fatal weakness—the green heart-core.
og_title: Realm of Annihilation: Ji Ning's Final Stand
og_description: Trapped in a dead world, with no escape and all hope lost, Ji Ning's Heartforce transforms, and he makes a chilling vow to drag his enemies to oblivion.
twitter_description: Surrounded and outmatched in a dead universe, Ji Ning discovers a shocking weakness in his enemies and unlocks the third stage of Heartforce—Mastery.

lore_anchors.definition: The dark, featureless void between the Three Realms and the greater Chaosverse, stripped of all Heavenly Daos except for the Chaos Heavenly Dao.
The absolute, supreme ruler of the Broken Horn World, a terrifying being who commands a hive-minded civilization and survived the ancient war against the Three Realms.
A top-ten divine ability created by Daoist Threelives; the fourth cycle allows Ji Ning to use his hands as weapons comparable to Pure Yang magic treasures.
The supreme body-tempering divine ability beneath the True God level; grants near-indestructibility and the ability to regenerate from a single speck of flesh.
A formless metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart; its third stage, 'Mastery,' grants perfect self-control and is the peak of divine archers in the Three Realms.
A high-level immortal existence capable of forcibly refining Innate spirit treasures; the suspected power level of the Broken Horn World's master.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning shatter his own body?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He used the Eight-Nine Arcane Art to reduce himself to a speck of dust, hoping to escape detection, but the enemy commander ordered them to collect every single fragment.
A small green orb inside each black-cloaked warrior; destroying it permanently kills the warrior, whereas normally they can regenerate from almost any wound.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How does Heartforce differ from Ki or Divine Power?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Heartforce is a will-based power that refines a cultivator's Dao-heart; it allows for perfect mental control and, at high levels, can even influence reality, but it does not directly increase combat damage.
